pdf.title: PDF Tools for Merge, Split, Compression, OCR, and Conversion
pdf.description: Open the live PDF tools directly from this page. Merge files, split pages, compress size, add watermarks, insert page numbers, run OCR, and convert PDF files to Word, Excel, HTML, JPG, PNG, PowerPoint, and text.

image.title: Image Tools for Compression, Conversion, Editing, and Cleanup
image.description: Open the live image tools directly from this category page. Compress files, convert formats, resize, crop, flip, rotate, remove metadata, add watermarks, and generate optimized AVIF or WebP output.

finance.title: Finance Tools for Planning, Loans, Tax, and Long-Term Decisions
finance.description: Open the live financial tools directly from this category page. Calculate mortgage refinance options, compound growth, retirement projections, crypto tax, loan planning, and other personal finance scenarios.

developer.title: Developer Tools for Formatting, Testing, and Code Utilities
developer.description: Open the live developer tools directly from this category page. Format JSON, test regex, minify CSS and JS, convert Base64, generate UUIDs, validate JSON, and more.

text.title: Text Tools for Counting, Formatting, Converting, and Cleanup
text.description: Open the live text tools directly from this category page. Count words and characters, convert text case, generate lorem ipsum, encode entities, create slugs, compare text, transform text to ASCII, and handle URL-safe output.

converters.title: Converters for Units, Numbers, and Data Formats
converters.description: Open the live converter tools directly from this category page. Convert between units, number bases, currencies, time zones, and data formats.

all.title: All Tools — Online Utilities by Category
all.description: Explore available tools organized by category, including PDF, image, finance, developer, text, and converters.
